lines: Chitthi na koi sandesh, chitthi na koi sandesh
Jaane woh kaun sa desh, jahaan tum chale gaye
couplets.en: No letter, no word, and who knows what land you have gone to?

lines: Jahaan tum chale gaye
Is dil pe laga ke thes, jaane woh kaun sa desh, jahaan tum chale gaye
couplets.en: Who knows what land you have gone to, leaving this heart bruised?

lines: Ek aah bhari hogi, humne na suni hogi
Jaate jaate tumne aawaaz to di hogi
couplets.en: You must have sighed and called out as you left, and we must have missed it.

lines: Har waqt yahi hai gham, us waqt kahaan the hum
Kahaan tum chale gaye
couplets.en: The same sorrow returns every moment, where were we then, and where did you go?

lines: Har cheez pe ashkon se likha hai tumhaara naam
couplets.en: Your name is written in tears on everything.

lines: Ye raste, ghar, galiyaan tumhein kar na sake salaam
Haaye dil mein reh gayi baat, jaldi se chhuda kar haath, kahaan tum chale gaye
couplets.en: These roads, houses, and lanes never got to say farewell, and the words stayed in my heart as you slipped your hand free and went.

lines: Ab yaadon ke kaante is dil mein chubhte hain, na dard thaharta hai, na aansoo rukte hain
Tumhein dhoondh raha hai pyaar, hum kaise karein iqraar ke haan tum chale gaye
couplets.en: Memories prick at the heart, the ache and tears go on, and love still looks for you when we cannot bring ourselves to say you are gone.

lines: Ho kahaan tum chale gaye, ho kahaan tum chale gaye
